name: Collet Lloyd
source:
Colette has worked for the Ashley family for a number of years as a maid. However, Colette is very clumsy and is always breaking things. Despite this, she’s always trying her best to do better and is always optimistic about a situation. She also enjoys reading a lot and even enjoys writing her own stories.

[From [url=http://liemyx.wordpress.com/2011/05/16/rondo-leaflet-review/]Liemyx's blog[/url]]
